title: Deflection-and-Recover Circuit
description: A defender tips passes in a small passing circle, then immediately recovers to a balanced stance — training active hands without losing position.

content.objective: Get active hands into passing lanes without losing defensive balance afterward.
content.setup: Three passers surround one defender in the middle who tries to deflect passes.
instructions: Passers move the ball quickly around the triangle.
The defender reaches to deflect any pass while staying balanced enough to recover.
After any deflection attempt, the defender resets immediately into a defensive stance.
coachingPoints: Reach with one hand only, keeping the base balanced.
Recover to a stance immediately after every attempt.
Read the passer's eyes to anticipate the pass, without guessing wildly.
commonMistakes: Lunging with the whole body and losing balance on every attempt.
Standing upright after a deflection instead of resetting the stance.
Watching the ball only and losing track of the opponent.
content.safety: Reach for the ball only, never for a passer's arms or hands.
